payload.allocator_used_by_these_runs: niche_evidence (the REPAIRED allocator, confirmed in each campaign manifest)
payload.consequence_for_the_controller: Donor recombination draws donors from the run's OWN scored population. If that population has drifted to median QED 0.3, recombining it yields more of the same. The construction-lane chemical prior is therefore not an independent nice-to-have -- it is what keeps the donor mechanism's inputs on the manifold. Measured earlier: the prior cuts mean dSA 0.519 -> 0.331 (sigma -6.3) and suppresses heteroatom-onto-heteroatom placement ~15-18x, but was wired at a call site reaching only 8.8% of proposals whose five families all preserve heavy-atom count -- so atom_insert and atom_delete, the two largest net-negative families, never routed through it.

inferred_not_established.status: NOT ESTABLISHED at n=11; the qed mechanism is the solid part, the cross-task correlation is indicative

measured.isomers_is_the_predicted_exception: the ONLY task whose heavy-atom median FALLS (21.5 -> 14.5), drifting TOWARD its small C7H8N2O2 target, and the only non-qed task above 90% of anchor
measured.reward_hacking_signature: gsk3b/jnk3/perindopril grow to 31-36 heavy atoms while losing 0.31-0.36 QED

payload.mechanism: qed is the one task whose OBJECTIVE is drug-likeness, so the objective itself pins the search to the drug-like manifold. Every other task's objective does not, the search leaves the manifold, and the productive regions are ON it. This explains the Test C pattern WITHOUT the narrow-vs-broad taxonomy, which the complete data already refuted.
payload.note: recomputed from the committed Test C blind ledgers; no new scoring
payload.question: Why does blind PMO search fail to discover productive regions on 10 of 11 tasks?
payload.what_this_rules_out: The parent allocator is NOT the remaining cause. These runs used niche_evidence -- the repair that replaced fragment niche centres -- and the drift persists at 0.10-0.36 QED. The allocator fix was necessary and is not sufficient.
